verified.description: A United States-based company that designs, builds, and deploys data centers in space using proprietary technology. In November 2025, Starcloud launched Starcloud-1 equipped with an Nvidia H100 GPU, and in March 2026 raised a $170M Series A at a $1.1bn valuation.
